    accuracy_score, confusion_matrix, f1_score,
    precision_score, recall_score,

        return 1

        return 0
    fail_kw = ["error", "assert", "traceback", "exception", "fail"]
    pass_kw = ["pass", "success", "completed"]
    has_fail = any(p in text_lower for p in fail_kw)
